what: Two large dark circles (57% of the section width, overlapping by 9% at the center) hide the back image behind pinned text, and from when the section head touches the top of the screen until the section end touches the bottom, tied to scroll (scrub 1, power1.out) each shrinks from 1 to .4 anchored on its inner edge, opening the photo strips on both sides — at the entrance of the ”Story” section

options.ease: Curve (GSAP name or 0.25,1,0.5,1 form), default power1.out (the original puts it in the timeline without a curve, so the GSAP default applies)
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: Circle (child) to shrink — data-key="left" if so, the right edge, "right" Given relative to the surface’s left edge. Centered if absent
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: (optional) Pinned panel holding the circle and text — fx.css sets position: sticky; give top: 0

use:
Center Text

Photo strip opening from behind

from.where: index.html .h-story__intro (two dark ink circles .h-story__disc.l·r) — original .home_story--intro_txt .bg-deco turned into a gsap timeline with scrub 1

note: Circle size and position default to fx.css (section width 57%, the circle’s inner edge crosses 4.5% past the center) and are overridden in the consuming css. The background image must pass beneath the circle, so give the sticky panel a z-index and keep the background image lower than it
